if_i_were_the_investor.q: If already holding, hold, reduce or sell?
if_i_were_the_investor.a: Hold if you are already long فملی above 18,800, but do not add until confirmation (>20,000 on volume + real-money inflow). Reduce if price rises on deteriorating flow or if 18,800 breaks on expanding volume.

if_i_were_the_investor.a: فراورده نفتي (Petroleum Products) and محصولات چوبي (Wood Products) — weakest relative strength, negative momentum, crack-spread and margin pressure.
فملی (FMLI) on a confirmed pullback to accumulation zone with volume, or a breakout above 20,000 with real-money flow. Options only after spot confirms direction; avoid high-IV naked calls.

if_i_were_the_investor.q: What is the most dangerous setup?
if_i_were_the_investor.a: Buying فملی or any copper-linked stock on an extended green candle without volume/flow confirmation, or selling naked puts on شبندر/شپنا while refinery cracks and Hormuz risk are elevated.

if_i_were_the_investor.q: What single event would reverse the view?
if_i_were_the_investor.a: Hormuz closure or severe new sanctions (reverses bull to bear immediately), OR a verified TSETMC print showing real-money outflow with price rising (distribution signal).
